text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a sudden gap in token-latency histograms for /generate and /chat routes starting ~1765432000. Per-route p50/p95 look unchanged but the per-token breakdown is missing buckets. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

kevin: yep I saw alerts from metrics-bot: 'statsd: metric drop detected' around the same time. Thought it was an exporter restart.

sre-bot: ALERT: statsd_exporter dropped 12k metrics in 5m (to: otel-collector). Check collector queue/backpressure.

jon: I pulled the otel-collector logs — there were repeated TLS handshake errors to the remote ingestion endpoint, and the receiver started sampling at 100/s due to mem pressure. Could be why histograms truncated.

lina: also correlates with the kernel-selection bump on runtime (new kernel v2.3.0) that changed batching heuristics — that caused KV-cache churn per shard. KV cache churn increases metric emission cardinality and then the sampler kicks in.

maria: good point. timeline: 1765431900 kernel rollout started, 1765431980 batching warmup peaked, 1765432005 collector started dropping. So likely a combined effect.

kevin: can we confirm if sampling is happening in the statsd->otel path or inside the collector? jon, what do logs show for receiver=sampler?

jon: collector config shows 'metrics/sampling: 100' from last deploy. Logs: 'sampler: rate limit reached, dropping 78% of incoming series'. Pasting snippet:
```
2026-02-15T12:06:45Z sampler.go:120 WARN sampler rate limit reached: 100/s
2026-02-15T12:06:50Z queue.go:88 ERROR enqueue failed: queue full
```

lina: that matches. Kernel change raised unique metric cardinality (kvcache.shard.* per request) so sampler suppressed bucketed histograms. Fix options: 1) reduce cardinality (turn off per-shard tag), 2) raise sampler limit, 3) route high-volume metrics to a dedicated pipeline.

maria: prefer option 3 for now. We should also backfill the missing token-level histograms for the last 12 minutes. Can we run backfill from persisted statsd logs? kevin?

kevin: yes, we have buffered statsd gzip files in s3://redwood-metrics/ingest/17654319*/ . Plan: run a backfill job to re-process those files through the offline pipeline that writes to the TSDB. Command:
```
./tools/metrics-backfill --source s3://redwood-metrics/ingest/17654319* \\
  --target prom-remote --preserve-buckets --time-window 1765431900,1765432200
```
I'll kick it off in ~5m.

jon: also suggest temporary tweak to collector: increase sampler to 500/s and bump queue size to 10k to avoid immediate drops while backfill runs. Then we can finalize routing.

lina: bump sounds fine as a short-term mitigation. I'll prepare a quick PR to pin collector config and add a dashboard panel for 'sampler drop rate' and 'kvcache-cardinality'.

maria: thanks. Action items: kevin run backfill (comment when started), lina PR for collector tweak + dashboard, jon monitor TLS/collector health, maria will roll kernel back if drops continue. :white_check_mark:

kevin: backfill job started 1765432130. logs: uploading 12 files -> processing. will update with completion time.

jon: collector sampler increased to 500/s at 1765432145. monitoring panels show drops decreasing.

maria: great. leaving this thread open for completion notes. thx all.
